eslint/no-restricted-properties.message: localeCompare orders by the host's ICU locale, so two machines running the same build can disagree. Everything here sorts into a cache key, a fingerprint, or a file the build writes: use compareCodeUnits/compareEntryKeys from packages/ruvyxa/runtime/order.mjs, compareStable in packages/ruvyxa/src/plugins/shared.ts, or a bare .sort() for a string array.

toLocaleLowerCase answers by the host's ICU locale, so a Turkish host lowercases `I` to `ı` where every other host and the Rust compiler give `i` — the same divergence localeCompare is banned for. Case-fold build output (heading slugs, ids, titles, cache keys) with toLowerCase(). If the feature genuinely takes a locale from the user, pass it explicitly and disable this rule on that line with the reason.

toLocaleUpperCase answers by the host's ICU locale, so a Turkish host uppercases `i` to `İ` where every other host gives `I`. Case-fold build output with toUpperCase(). If the feature genuinely takes a locale from the user, pass it explicitly and disable this rule on that line with the reason.
